name: Lendvajakabfa (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lendvajakabfa: a red and white shield with a wall and a ploughshare, with a helm, a crown, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling, above a yellow scroll inscribed LENDVAJAKABFA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Lendvajakabfa arms with helm, crown, crest, mantling and scroll
